rows.en: And this Naager friend of yours… just what are they after? Sneaking around like that!!

Hey, Hayato! Knock it off! If Takeshi were alive…

Ah, no… I mean, uh…
Oyassan… Hongo isn't going to die. Never… I know it. That guy…

…!?

W-who's there?
What's wrong, Hayato? Is somebody there?
Oyassan… Somebody left this in front of the shop…

Who!? Who brought a thing like that? It's a funeral wreath! Hm… what's this?

"Our heartfelt condolences on the death of Kamen Rider! General Black, Head of the Gel-Shocker Japan Branch…"

Damn it… The shameless nerve of them!!
I won't forgive this… Gel-Shocker, General Black!
Hey, Hayato! Where are you going? Hey!
Hayato is hurting terribly, isn't he? I feel sorry for him…
[HERO4], 'sorry for him'… Don't tell me… You understand that? That feeling?

Ah, no… It was only a feeling I had.

It is impossible for an organic droid like me to perceive emotions.

No…

Maybe, just like Jiro and Ichiro, you've got one of those Conscience Circuits too…
You mustn't, [HERO2]… You mustn't think such things… such things…

Now, now… Anyway… It's not all gloomy news!

After all, we've got a captain of the Galactic Patrol here! Right, Mr. "Captain" Gavan?
Ehehe… Please quit it with the "Captain", Oyassan.
What're you saying? It's a promotion! That's something to celebrate… right, everyone?
Well… uh… you've got me… I just can't win against you, Oyassan! Hahahaha…

As a result of scanning Ichijouji's average expression rate…

he is displaying a smile 35.8% or more beyond normal levels.
Even you, [HERO4]…
You're joking, right?
Yes, I am joking.

Jeez, honestly…

But really, [HERO4], I get the feeling you've become, like… how should I put it… brighter than before.
Is that so? I cannot tell, myself…

Oh, I know!

Tonight, let's throw a party to celebrate Retsu's promotion! How should I put it… we'll blow all this gloom away, like… bam! Right? Okay, I'm closing up shop for today.
Even so… I wonder what kind of people these Madou are.

They're said to be a band of evil espers…

In Genmu World, the other-dimensional space that serves as their base, Demon King Psycho reigns as ruler! Though nobody has ever actually seen him.
Besides, that Naager friend of yours is bound to be mixed up in this too, right? Skulking around behind the scenes… just what are they after?
Oyassan… Hongo won't die. Never… I know it. That guy…
Ichimonji, you're really hurting, huh? I get how you feel, but…
I can understand him getting irritable, too.
Yeah… But I hope he's okay, Hongo, I mean.

Retsu… I get how you feel.

The first time I got picked as group leader in elementary school, my heart was pounding a little… but I felt kinda happy, too.

[HERO4]… A Space Sheriff's job isn't the same as an elementary-school group leader's!

It's more like… how should I put it… junior-high level!
Hahaha… Retsu, you're really over the moon, aren't you?
Yeah! Don't get so fired up that you mess up!
Yes, yes, I got it.
But really, congrats. You worked hard for it, didn't you, Retsu?
This is Genmu World… the other-dimensional space in which Genmu Castle, stronghold of the Space Crime Secret Society Madou, lies hidden.
General Guiler… Every second counts in the plan to invade Earth! Go at it with everything you have!
Those who get in our way need only be erased. Send in a Demon Beast…
Kyaooo!!
Iiiih!
First, paint Tokyo over with Madou's black blood! Make Japan our base and begin the invasion of Earth!
Sir…

Takeshi… Are you really dead?

I talk tough in front of everyone, but I… I feel like I'm losing the strength to do anything at all.

My dream, my hope… What am I supposed to hold on to in my heart to keep fighting evil?

Oh, that's right… Gavan got promoted to captain! Everyone's working hard… doing your share too. …Rest in peace.
Take care, Hongo… I'll always be watching over you! No matter how far apart we are!
…!? Gel-Shocker?
My name is General Guiler, in charge of Madou's strategy division! As the first step of the invasion of Earth, I shall kill you!!

If this thing's started moving, it means Takeshi's calling it with the remote control!

Hahaha… If I just ride along on it, I'll get to Takeshi even if I sleep the whole way!

Still, that Takeshi… if he's alive, he could've at least sent word that he's alive…

No, no, wait a minute. Maybe… he's been captured by Gel-Shocker? Jeez, making me worry like this!
Oyassan!? Talk about a lifesaver!
What? Hayato, is that you? Where's Takeshi?
Takeshi Hongo has left Japan…
He went abroad?
That's right.
Hayato, Oyassan!
Taki… Takeshi's gone off abroad.
Abroad?
He's chasing another of Gel-Shocker's plans!
By the way, you… what are you doing here?
It's not just me! I can't let Hayato be the only one who gets to look cool!
Taki, look after Oyassan for me! Let's go!

Double Monsteeer!!

I have fused Doubleman's intellect with a Monster's power… Hahahaha! Let's settle this, Gavan!!
Bring it on, Makuuu!! I'll fight, and fight, and fight to the very end! Johchaku!!
Space Sheriff Gavan takes a mere 0.05 seconds to don his Combat Suit. Now let's watch the Johchaku process once more.

Captain Gavan!! I have just arrived on Earth!

Makuu, Madou!! I won't let you do as you please with this beautiful Earth! Sekisha!!
Ooh!?
Space Sheriff Sharivan!!
Space Sheriff Sharivan completes his Sekisha Johchaku in 1 millisecond. Now let's watch the Sekisha process once more!
The blazing energy of the sun sparks into the Grand Birth's amplification system.
The amplified solar energy is converted into Solar Metal and clad onto Sharivan by Sekisha Johchaku.
So he's the new Space Sheriff? I guess number 2 always has to be red, huh.
So he's the new Space Sheriff? I guess number 2 always has to be red, huh.
Nngh, as expected of a Space Sheriff… Come forth, Demon Beast Gori Beast!!
Drag them into Genmu World…
Genmu World generator, activate!!
Genmu World is a kind of white hole. Vast quantities of matter sucked into a black hole are broken down into atoms and spewed back out.
It is a demonic space where light and heat swirl. In Genmu World, Demon Beasts can wield several times their normal power.
Hmph… Today I only came to probe you, but next time, be ready!

uncertain: U02976: wreath card says ゲルダムショッカー; rendered as Gel-Shocker for consistency.
U02979/U02980: 可哀想 rendered 'I feel sorry for him' so [HERO2]'s echo works; Hayato is male.
U02981: 官機ドロイド read as 有機ドロイド 'organic droid' (glyph).
U02996: Psycho referred to as 'him' (Demon King).
U03012: 'Kyaooo!!' is assigned to Demon King Psycho; may really be the Demon Beast's cry, kept as is.
U03021: 地獄に仏 rendered idiomatically as 'Talk about a lifesaver!'
U03035/U03039/U03041: 蒸着 in narration rendered as 'don' / 'Johchaku process'.
U03042: joke about Kamen Rider 2 (red) and Sharivan being the second Space Sheriff.
